parts.tooltip: State s a — a computation: given state s returns (a, s')
(a ⟶ State s b) — continuation: given result a, produces a new state computation
s — current state entering bind. The value side and the state side are both threaded.

bind sa f = \s ->
  let (a, s')  = sa(s)    -- run sa: get result a and new state s'
      (b, s'') = f(a)(s') -- run f(a) with s': get b and final state s''
  in  (b, s'')
State s b — the composed computation; when run it produces (b, s'')
s — the transformed state after both sa and f(a) have run. Different from s_in.
